name: Lametasaurus
isnote: Described by Matley in 1924 from material now regarded as a chimera including ornithischian remains (Rozadilla et al. 2021 cited by Wikipedia).
sum: Chimeric dinosaur genus from the Lameta Formation of Jabalpur, India, collected between 1917 and 1919.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Not given in the sources used.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Matley 1924
